project.name: wiremock-stubgen-fixtures
project.description:
The specification the project is designed against, and the code that hands it to a test as a file.
It lived in the core module's test resources and reached the Java target through a test jar, which read as "the core's fixture, borrowed". It is not: it is the one specification every layer is measured against, and each layer has an equal claim on it. A module of its own says that, and removes the test-jar dependency that only existed to carry a single file.
A test aid, not a product artifact: built and installed so the reactor can use it, never deployed.
